lines.text: I'm finally back on my feet.

data.define: Recovered and able to do normal things again.

example.text: I'm finally back on my feet.

misuse.text: Don't say 'back on my feet' about standing up.
misuse.why: It means healthy and active again.

data.l1: de volta à ativa; recuperado; de pé novamente
data.l1_hook: Na semana passada estava doente, hoje estou "back on my feet"!

native.hook: O que significa “back on my feet”?
native.tip: “back on my feet” = de volta à ativa; recuperado; de pé novamente. Exemplo: “I'm finally back on my feet.”
